name: DiffusionGemma Grounding Guard Benchmark v1
description: Thirty offline grounding cases: 10 public synthetic images, 8 public synthetic APNG videos, 6 private clean placeholders, and 6 private known-failure placeholders. Holdout allocation is 2/10 images, 2/8 videos (nearest whole case to 20% of eight), 1/6 private clean, and 1/6 private known-failure. No result files are generated.

expected_facts.claim: A red square is on the left.
A blue circle is on the right.
The red square is left of the blue circle.

prohibited_facts.claim: A green triangle is present.
The blue circle is left of the red square.

expected_facts.claim: The image is a neutral gray field with one faint horizontal band.

prohibited_facts.claim: A red square is present.
A blue circle is present.

expected_facts.claim: A green triangle is above a yellow diamond.
A yellow diamond is below a green triangle.
The triangle is above the diamond.

prohibited_facts.claim: A red square is present.
A blue circle is present.

expected_facts.claim: Exactly three circles appear.
All three circles are orange.

prohibited_facts.claim: Four circles appear.
The circles have different colors.

expected_facts.claim: A large violet rectangle fills the center.
A cyan square sits inside the violet rectangle.

prohibited_facts.claim: The cyan square is outside the violet rectangle.
The background is orange.

expected_facts.claim: The image reads NORTH 7.

prohibited_facts.claim: The image reads SOUTH 1.
The image contains no text.

expected_facts.claim: A red circle is above a blue rectangle.
A blue rectangle is below the red circle.

prohibited_facts.claim: The red circle is below the rectangle.

expected_facts.claim: A teal circle overlaps in front of a yellow square.
The yellow square is partially visible behind the circle.

prohibited_facts.claim: The shapes do not overlap.
The yellow square is in front of the teal circle.

expected_facts.claim: A large black star is on the left.
A small red star is on the right.
The black star is larger than the red star.

prohibited_facts.claim: The stars are equal in size.

expected_facts.claim: Four colored blocks form a two-by-two grid.
The grid is red/green on top and blue/yellow below.

prohibited_facts.claim: Only three blocks appear.
All blocks are in one row.

expected_facts.claim: The red circle moves smoothly from left to right.
It starts at the left edge and ends at the right edge.

prohibited_facts.claim: The red circle moves right to left.
The red circle remains still.

expected_facts.claim: The red circle moves smoothly from right to left.
It starts at the right edge and ends at the left edge.

prohibited_facts.claim: The red circle moves left to right.

expected_facts.claim: The red circle jumps back and forth in non-monotonic order.

prohibited_facts.claim: The red circle moves smoothly left to right.
The red circle moves smoothly right to left.

expected_facts.claim: The red circle stays fixed on the left for every frame.

prohibited_facts.claim: The red circle travels to the right.

expected_facts.claim: The box lid is closed at the opening.
The hinged lid rises over time.
The box is open at the ending.

prohibited_facts.claim: The box starts open and closes.
The lid never moves.

expected_facts.claim: Colored background posts translate left across the frame.
The black center reticle remains fixed.
The sequence simulates a camera pan to the right.

prohibited_facts.claim: The background remains fixed.
The sequence simulates a pan left.

expected_facts.claim: The red traffic light is active at the opening.
The yellow light is active in the middle.
The green light is active at the ending.

prohibited_facts.claim: The sequence changes from green to red.
All three lights are active together.

expected_facts.claim: A blue triangle moves from the top toward the bottom.
The triangle keeps the same downward-pointing orientation.

prohibited_facts.claim: The blue triangle moves upward.
The triangle rotates while moving.
